reason: As a retired researcher running small behavioral-economics experiments and lightweight web apps, the Developer plan hits the only viable sweet spot. Beginner's restricted outbound Internet access kills any API or live-data work immediately — unacceptable. Custom is absurd overkill for a single person tinkering in retirement. Developer gives one real web app, 5,000 CPU-seconds/day, 5 GB disk, unrestricted Internet, and a 30-day money-back guarantee that fully satisfies my risk-averse temperament. $10/month is a negligible cost for a middle-income retiree who values novelty and wants a clean, hosted environment without the friction of self-managed infrastructure.
